original_text: 剪纸的文化寓意是什么？
target_text: Based on the supplied sources, Paper Cutting (剪纸); cultural meaning can be explained through this point: 剪纸以剪刀或刻刀在纸上制作图案；常见纹样寄托人们对团圆、吉祥和美好生活的愿望。 This is a factual, source-grounded explanation. A comparison used to help understanding is only an analogy, not a historical fact. [CIT-001] [CIT-002]
